articles.summary: ASHEVILLE, N.C., Nov. 17, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- HomeTrust Bancshares, Inc. (NYSE: HTB) (“Company”), the holding company of HomeTrust Bank (“HomeTrust” or the “Bank”), announced today that the Bank has earned three distinguished awards honoring its workplace culture at a national level.
articles.title: HomeTrust Bank Recognized Nationally with Three Workplace Awards, Advances to Top 100 Most Loved Workplace®
